cases.title: Excalibur
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Excalibur''' is a one-handed [[sword]] and a [[quest item]] obtained from the [[Merlin's Crystal]] [[quest]] and used in the [[Holy Grail]] quest. It requires 20 [[Attack]] to wield and has similar [[equipment stats|stats]] to the [[adamant longsword]], except for 6 less [[strength bonus]] and 1 more magic defence.

exactVariantFacts.value: This used to belong to King Arthur.

cases.title: Holy water
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Holy water''' is a consumable [[Ranged]] weapon that is used just like [[throwing knives]] and [[dart]]s; however, it will only deal damage against [[Demon (attribute)|demons]]. Throwing holy water will cause the vial to break, dropping [[smashed glass]] on the floor. As a [[demonbane weapon]], it has an [[attribute affinity]] for demons; the item's max hit is increased by 60% in a similar fashion to that of [[Silverlight]]. On top of that, it gains an additional +5 damage bonus if the demon is [[Nezikchened]]. Upon a [[successful hit]], it will drain the opponent's Defence level by 5%, provided it is a demon.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1569278023014170624|date=12 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108475|archivedate=13 September 2022|quote=[Hey Ash. A bit of an obscure question. But what accuracy / damage bonus does the holy water ranged weapon from legends quest gain against demons?] It gets a 1.6x damage multiplier (stacked with +5 damage if the demon is Nezikchened in that quest). The accuracy bonus is more to do with how it drains the target's Defence stat by 5%.|name=60%}} Multiple holy water hits '''will not''' stack their Defence reduction.

exactVariantFacts.value: A vial of holy water, good against certain demons.

cases.semanticExcerpt: '''holy book''' is a book held in place of a [[shield]], and is the [[god book]] aligned with [[Saradomin]]. God books are commonly used for their prayer bonus, something few shields offer. The Holy book is obtained from the [[Horror from the Deep]] quest. The book is received from the quest as just a cover, and requires 4 [[God page#Holy book|Saradomin pages]] obtained from [[Treasure Trails]] to be completed. The book will not give any bonuses (with the exception of the +5 prayer bonus) until it is completed. An incomplete holy book does count as a Saradomin item in the [[Hallowed Sepulchre]]. With 50 [[Prayer]] and a completed book, players can enchant [[Unblessed symbol|unblessed symbols]] into [[holy symbol]]s.

cases.title: Void knight mace
cases.semanticExcerpt:
'''Void Knight mace''' can be bought from a [[Void Knight]] for 250 [[commendation points]], although a player must have 42 [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Hitpoints]], [[Ranged]], and [[Magic]], along with 22 [[Prayer]]. The mace can be used to [[autocast]] [[Claws of Guthix]], [[Crumble Undead]], and the [[Wave spells|Wave]] and [[Surge spells]]. To cast Claws of Guthix, the player must have cast the spell 100 times in the [[Wilderness]] [[Mage Arena]]. 
Note that the Void knight mace does '''not''' count towards the four pieces needed for the [[Void Knight equipment#Set effects|void set effect]].

cases.title: Dorgeshuun crossbow
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Dorgeshuun crossbow''' is a [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]] requiring level 28 [[Ranged]] to equip. It is often used to train [[Ranged]] at low to medium levels, due to it having several advantages over similar [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]s with the same level requirements. It has the same attack bonus as an [[iron crossbow]]. It has an attack speed that is one [[tick]] faster than most other crossbows, and it is able to fire [[bone bolt]]s, which are significantly cheaper than most other ammunition of similar strength. The fact it is a crossbow also gives it an advantage over [[shortbow]]s, allowing the use of the [[shield slot]] for defensive or offensive purposes. Despite the bone bolts being roughly equivalent to iron bolts in ranged strength, the Dorgeshuun crossbow's faster attack speed means that its damage-per-second output when firing bone bolts is comparable to that of a regular crossbow firing steel or even mithril bolts (depending on the player's exact Ranged level).

Unlike other ammunition, it requires 28 [[Ranged]] to equip.

cases.title: Runite bolts

They require a [[Ranged]] level of 61 to equip.

Unlike [[spear|other spears]], it cannot be [[poison]]ed, and has its highest bonus in [[stab]], while other spears have the same bonus on all melee attack styles. The Zamorakian spear offers the fourth highest stab bonus of all weapons at +85, shared with the [[Zamorakian hasta]], [[dragon hunter lance]], and [[crystal halberd]]. It is outmatched by the [[Ghrazi rapier]] with a stab bonus of +94, the [[Belle's folly|Belle’s folly]] with a stab bonus of +100 and the [[Osmumten's fang|Osmumten's Fang]] with a stab bonus of +105.

cases.title: Broad bolts
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Broad bolts''' (or '''broad-tipped bolts''') are bolts used for a [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]. They provide the same [[Ranged Strength|ranged strength]] as [[adamant bolts]] (+100). Players can buy a set of 250 for 35 [[Slayer reward point]]s from any [[Slayer master]]. Broad bolts, or their [[broad arrow|arrow equivalents]], are required by players who intend to slay [[Turoth]] or [[Kurasks]] using [[Ranged]].

cases.title: Barronite mace
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Barronite mace''' is a crush melee weapon that can be obtained within the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]], requiring 40 [[Attack]] to wield. Its bonuses are comparable to that of a [[rune mace]], but it provides higher melee strength and crush accuracy bonuses at the cost of a lower prayer bonus. It also has a 15% damage and accuracy bonus against [[Golem (attribute)|golem]]s, including those within the dungeon. Unlike regular metal maces, the barronite mace offers [[blunt]] rather than [[Weapons/Types#Spiked weapons|spiked]] attack styles, which means it can only be used for [[crush]] attacks, despite having a notable [[stab]] accuracy bonus. For [[free-to-play]] and low level players, this mace is a good alternative to the [[rune scimitar]] when fighting golems thanks to its [[Golem (attribute)|golembane]] effect and it is the second-best free-to-play weapon in most other situations, outperforming the [[rune sword]] in both strength and attack bonus. For those with membership, the golembane effect stacks with the [[black mask]] or [[slayer helmet]] effect while on a [[Gargoyle]] slayer task.

exactVariantFacts.value: Made from the unearthly material, barronite.

cases.title: Blue Moon spear
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Blue Moon spear''' is a non-degradable two-handed [[bladed staff]] that requires level 70 [[Attack]] and 75 [[Magic]] to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the [[Lunar Chest]] in [[Neypotzli]]. Despite the name, the Blue Moon spear is not a [[Weapons/Categories#Spear|spear]] and '''not''' considered a [[Corpbane weapons|corpbane weapon]].

cases.title: Sunspear
cases.semanticExcerpt:
'''Sunspear''' is a two-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Spear|spear]] given as a reward after completion of [[The Blood Moon Rises]] quest. Originally created by Queen [[Efaritay Hallow]], the Sunspear was her weapon of choice, made from blisterwood and pure silvthrill.{{CiteNPC|npc=Efaritay Hallow|quote=I take it you have noticed the spear Drakan carries? [Player: I have. I must say, it doesn't look like a particularly vampyric weapon.] That's because it's not. It's called the Sunspear and I made it myself from blisterwood and pure silvthrill. It was one of the many things Drakan took from me.
|loc=The Blood Moon Rises}} It was taken by [[Lowerniel Drakan]] after his conquest of Hallowvale, where he would wield it as his own weapon until his death. If lost, the item can be retrieved from [[Efaritay's Supplies]] in [[Castle Drakan]] for 100,000 coins.
